name: runtime-upgrade
title: Agent Runtime 架构升级（Workflow-centric → Kernel-centric）
creator: codex
notes:
CLOSE-OUT (2026-09-18). VERDICT: 9/9 children delivered, 51 PRs (#577-627) contiguous with no gaps. The judgement is measured, not read off the ledger: every merged PR in the window was attributed by the ticket prefix in its title, giving 51/51 attributed and the nine ticket ranges tiling #577-627 exactly. The ledger's own fields are not trustworthy in this repo -- a multi-slice ticket's task.json.commit holds only its last slice (P0/P1b/P1c/P1d hold none at all) and status still reads in_progress after delivery, so the commit graph is the only evidence. PER TICKET: P0 #577 (1) concurrent-state isolation, retry consolidation, publish idempotence, quality gate fail-closed; P1a #578 (1) ArtifactStore/EventStore/hydration + the three-layer state split; P1b #579-590 (12) recall through compile, prompt L0-L5 layering, per-agent migration, baseline gate; P1c #591-599 (9) ToolSpec + Registry + Gateway with every call site re-routed; P1d #600-605 (6) provider-native structured output; P2a #606-613 (8) PublishIntent + deterministic policy engine + human authorisation + Action Executor; P2b #614-617 (4) the lease data plane plus takeover and self-fencing plus the execution-plane contract; P2c #618-623 (6) the Plan read export, exhaustive template registry, mode/Goal convergence and the workflow.py layering; P3 #624-627 (4) the weak-label contract, its producer, and the outcome- learning contract document. TARGET STATE, COMPONENT BY COMPONENT: Agent Kernel = backend/state/**; Task Graph = state/machine.py + modes.py + docs/planning.md; Context Compiler = backend/context/**; Tool Gateway = backend/tools/runtime/**; Durable Scheduler = db/execution_leases.py + routes/_takeover.py + graph/takeover_safety.py; Decision/Action = creator_agent/policy.py + agents/nodes/publish_gate.py. Memory Fabric is the one component only half-built: the read side is unified, the write side is deliberately not (ruling 7 below). And LangGraph is only partly demoted to a Task Graph Executor -- judgement and execution moved Kernel-side, but the graph still orchestrates the mainline, which is the direct consequence of ruling 2. EIGHT REGISTERED ITEMS, NOT FIXED -- closing the parent does not change their standing and does not mean they are accepted as final: (1) two publish-retry paths are neither migrated nor taken over, invisible after a restart, and they are exactly the paths a previous unfinished run would take (P2b; ranked fix list at the end of section 7); (2) the mainline still calls run_publish directly, so no PublishIntent is emitted and the policy engine is not consulted -- that half of the plan row was never built (P2a; orthogonal to the never-publish-without-authorisation property, and S5c wrote the contract down); (3) orchestrator_router answers copywriter for brief mode at phase=creating while builder.py's orchestrator map has no such key -- the P1d KeyError failure mode, on a reachable and untested branch (P2c); (4) should_brief_or_optimize has no caller at all, registered in ROUTERS_WITHOUT_AN_EDGE with a reverse assertion (P2c); (5) the two text-to-JSON parsers cannot merge, because the llm_enrichment copy's raise is the only trigger for fallback_fn while de_ai_taste depends on method == algorithmic -- pinned as TestTheTwoParsersCannotBeMerged (P1d); (6) the ripple-retry route still calls RippleService directly, the tool gate deliberately covering only backend/agents/** with the boundary documented at _ALLOWED_PREFIX (P1c); (7) Memory Fabric is unified on the read side only -- merging human-gated UserFeedback with automatic weak labels would change the human gate's semantics, so it waits for a conflicting-conclusion instance (P3); (8) the refit window is the sample's creation time while the write condition is once per sync, so an old row can be labelled and still move the counter by zero -- kept deliberately, and the gate only opens once a repeated back-fill is distinguishable from a new label, because late merely delays while wrong contaminates the weights (P3, ruled in docs/outcome-learning.md section 4). WHAT THIS CLOSE-OUT DID: promoted '9 children delivered' from ledger self-report to a recomputable map (51/51 attributed, ranges tiling the window), collected the eight registered items in one place, and archived the nine children plus this parent into archive/2026-09/ per the repo's own convention. WHAT IT DID NOT DO: no production code was touched, none of the eight items was quietly fixed, and no child's prd.md or notes was edited -- archiving flips status/completedAt and moves the directory, it does not rewrite. CAVEAT ON DATES: the archive tool writes completedAt as the archival day (2026-09-18); each child's real delivery date is in its notes' DELIVERED section and in the PR range above. ONE HISTORICAL DEVIATION CORRECTED IN PLACE: P0 existed in both tasks/ and archive/2026-09/ because a previous round copied it without deleting the original; the tasks/ leftover was removed so the tree matches the tool's move semantics. completedAt for P0 keeps its original 2026-09-13.
